statement: D-0093 (decided by Warren 2026-10-15): the case's FX date is the APPROVAL date, always. A stored daily rate may be up to 4 days older than that date. A manual rate needs a reason. A rate chosen at create or carried from an import is kept at approval. Supersedes the N-0083 build rule that dated the rate by the window start (or today if the window has not started). Reversible: one date rule in the case FX service.
